about: Ranks and facts .cursor/rules/forever-scoring.mdc states. check_gear.py fails when the generated lists disagree. A deliberate rescore that moves one of these updates this file in the same change. specs "*" means every spec of that class with a list in that slot. knownIssue reports without failing, and fails once it passes.
